[1/2] Progression cycle: surface failed profile saves in the debrief and keep an unwritable path from crashing the run; prove with a locked-profile death pair and drill

impact_assessment.why: A failed save only incremented profile_save_errors; the debrief looked normal while the run was lost, and a profile parent that cannot be created raised out of the finish.
impact_assessment.benefits: The death screen names PROFILE NOT SAVED in red, and a save-path failure loses only the run, never the crash-free finish.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: debrief draw + save error handling; dependency: none; concurrency: lock semantics unchanged; state: profile schema and sim untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for the silent debrief and the crash path, a locked-profile capture pair, a same-hash save_fail drill, and the full gate set.

[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: add DATA-driven viewmodel recoil (pull back/up with existing sim.kick), capture a scatter fire frame pair and verify a same-hash played drill

impact_assessment.why: Firing adds camera kick, but the gun is rigidly camera-parented: the gun never moves relative to the view, so recoil reads as the world tilting instead of the weapon kicking.
impact_assessment.benefits: The existing kick becomes a visible weapon punch with no new nodes, draws or sim state; DATA owns the amount.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: viewmodel presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, aim, hitbox or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first position/decay tests, a seeded scatter fire-frame pair at 960x540, and a strafe drill whose hash must not move.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first 20-seed test, staged platform capture pair, summon drill comparing blocked positions, and full gates.

[1/2] UI cycle: add a NO RESERVE second line to the near-crosshair low-ammo panel when the magazine runs dry, with a HUD pair and dry-fire parity

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-55 panel shows LOW AMMO <mag> but never says the reserve is empty, so the warning implies a reload will help when it cannot.
impact_assessment.benefits: The player can tell an empty reserve from an ordinary low magazine at the aim point; full counts stay in the engine status.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, ammo, input or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first label tests, the hud_ammo capture pair at 960x540, dry-fire hash parity and the full gates.

impact_assessment.benefits: A short expanding, rising orb pop marks the collection using the existing node and material, with no new nodes or draw types.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first burst/clear tests, a staged pickup pair at 960x540, pickup-drill hash parity and the full gates.
